basic_details.job_title: Unnao District Court Class & Sweeper Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Court (Janpad Nyayalaya) Unnao is filling 8 vacant posts – 7 Class IV (Chaturth Shreni) and 1 Sweeper – through re-employment of Class IV and Sweeper employees who have retired from the District Court. Applications in the prescribed format must be submitted at the Administrative Office by 5:00 PM on 17 November 2026; applications received after this time will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Unnao District Court Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit for applying, the application fee or the minimum educational qualification.

Last drawn pay on the post, paid as honorarium after deducting the pension amount
Prescribed form submitted at the Administrative Office

content_sections.heading: About Unnao District Court
content_sections.text: The District Court, Unnao is the district-level court in Unnao. This notice is issued by the Office of the Chairman, Selection Committee / District Judge, Unnao, in compliance with Allahabad High Court C.L. No. 14/Admin. (D) Section dated 15.10.2022, which covers re-employment of retired employees against vacant posts in the district court.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must fill in the application in the prescribed format annexed to the notice and submit it in the Administrative Office (Prashasnik Karyalaya), District Court, Unnao, by 5:00 PM on 17 November 2026. The notice does not mention sending the application by post or email. The prescribed form (titled "Application for employment on vacant post to be filled through re-employment of retired employees in District Court Unnao", as per C.L. No. 14/Admin "D" Section dated 15-10-2022) asks for: Name of the post applied for Applicant's name and father's / husband's name Date of birth and date of retirement Last post held and the name of the district court from which the applicant retired Details of a photo identity card (identity card / Aadhaar card / other valid identity card) Permanent address, temporary address, mobile number, email ID and educational qualification The form ends with an undertaking that the applicant is physically fit and able to work on the post in District Court, Unnao; that, to the applicant's knowledge, no penalty or entry hindering re-employment was given during service; that no criminal proceedings are pending against the applicant; and that no criminal or civil case against or related to the applicant is pending in District Court, Unnao. The applicant also certifies that all information is true, accepts responsibility and action if it is found false, and accepts all rules and conditions of the application. The form is signed with the date and place (Unnao).

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The same conditions apply to both posts: Who can apply: Class IV / Sweeper employees retired from the District Court. Fitness: The applicant must be physically and mentally fit. Service record: The applicant's character roll of the previous 5 years should be correct. No pending case: No criminal or civil case should be pending and registered against the applicant. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the form only asks applicants to state their educational qualification. Pay: The pay of the post will be the last drawn pay of the applicant on the concerned post, payable as honorarium after deducting the pension amount. The tenure of the selected employee will be 1 year from the date of joining, or until the post is filled by direct recruitment or promotion, or until the employee completes 65 years of age – whichever is earlier. The appointment will be purely temporary and can be terminated without any prior notice if service is not found satisfactory. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: A copy of the last drawn pay and pension order – attaching it with the application form is mandatory.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the applicant's past record and ACR will be the basis of appointment. The notice is issued by the Selection Committee headed by the District Judge, Unnao.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the prescribed time (5:00 PM, 17 November 2026) will not be considered. The notice is to be circulated among the retired employees of the district court and pasted on the court's notice board. The notice is also to be uploaded on the official websites of District Court Unnao and the High Court, and sent for publication in at least two daily newspapers.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Unnao District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 posts: 7 Class IV and 1 Sweeper, to be filled through re-employment of retired employees.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted at the Administrative Office by 5:00 PM on 17 November 2026; applications received later will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Class IV and Sweeper employees retired from the District Court can apply, provided they are physically and mentally fit and have no criminal or civil case pending and registered against them.

faq.question: Q4. What salary will the re-employed staff get?
faq.answer: The pay will be the applicant's last drawn pay on the concerned post, paid as honorarium after deducting the pension amount.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed format annexed to the notice, attach a copy of the last drawn pay and pension order, and submit it in the Administrative Office, District Court, Unnao, by 5:00 PM on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The applicant's past record and ACR will be the basis of appointment, and the character roll of the previous 5 years should be correct.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and can be terminated without prior notice if service is not satisfactory.

faq.question: Q8. How long will the re-employment last?
faq.answer: It lasts 1 year from joining, or until the post is filled by direct recruitment or promotion, or until the employee turns 65 – whichever is earlier.
